name: specify
description: Behavioral contracts, stable IDs, structural linting, and external test evidence

scripts.quality: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run validate && npm run format
scripts.validate: node --import tsx src/cli/index.ts spec lint --spec specify.spec
scripts.test: npm run build && find dist/src -name '*.test.js' -not -path '*/node_modules/*' | sort | xargs node --test
scripts.build: node --input-type=module -e "import { rmSync } from 'node:fs'; rmSync('dist', { recursive: true, force: true });" && tsc
